text:
Irene: Quick idea — adding a "quota impact preview" to saved queries in Console. When you change filters or rollout %, show estimated token cost and capacity delta before you save/apply. Thoughts?
Sam: Love it. Must show per-model cost breakdown and include fallback route costs (so teams know the worst-case).
Kevin: Two concerns: 1) live compute could be expensive, 2) permissions (who can run org-wide sims).
Maria: We already have telemetry histograms per-route and per-model. We can sample recent requests and project costs. Not perfect but good enough for a preview.
Irene: UX sketch: inline compact preview bar next to the saved query name. Click "Preview" to open a modal that simulates N requests and shows token totals, cost estimate, and a small table: model / pct / est tokens. Keep previews ephemeral until user hits "Save snapshot".
Sam: Also a toggle to "assume cache hits" (and a cache hit-rate slider). Caching affects token consumption a lot.
Maria: Agree. We'll surface a default cache-hit assumption from telemetry (30% by default) and let the user override.
TJ: RBAC: non-admins shouldn't be able to run cluster-wide simulations. For Dedicated customers show only their reserved capacity numbers.
Irene: Good call. Also want to persist a preview snapshot metadata on save: fields like preview_hash, last_previewed_by, rollout_snapshot.
Kevin: Backend sketch: new endpoint `POST /console/preview-cost?route=<id>` with body {filters, rollout_config, sample_count}. Returns estimate object. If estimation is long, return 202 + job id. Rate-limit this endpoint.
Maria: I'll prototype an internal endpoint in telemetry-service that returns median/95th token estimates by model and route for a given filter set. Could return summary within ~2s for typical queries.
TJ: Security wants audit logs for previews. Can we emit `console_preview_run` event with user, route, filter_hash, and job_id?
Irene: Yes — show audit link in modal footer. Also show a small warning if the preview uses historical data older than X days.
Kevin: Implementation note: to support UI responsivity, return a lightweight quick-estimate first (fast) and then stream a refined estimate. UI can show a loading spinner and update numbers.
Irene: Prototype plan: I'll wire up a minimal modal + preview bar in Console next sprint. @Maria can you scope the API and return a proto schema? If we can get 95% estimates in <2s it's good.
Maria: I'll add it to my sprint scope. Might fall back to job model for very wide filters. Will return 202 + job id in that case.
analytics-bot: Branch `feature/preview-cost` deployed to staging with sample endpoint `/staging/preview-cost` (internal only).
security-bot: Reminder — ensure feature respects data residency flags (don't include sample payloads for restricted customers).
Irene: Action items: 1) Maria: API prototype + perf targets; 2) Kevin: design streaming/202 behavior; 3) TJ/Security: RBAC + audit requirements; 4) Irene: console mock + modal.
Sam: :thumbsup: Can we add a small opt-in telemetry checkbox so we can measure accuracy of previews vs actuals?
Maria: Yes, opt-in only. We'll record preview vs actual deltas for those who consent.
Irene: Great. Okay I'll start the mock and drop screenshots here when ready.
